description: The graph illustrates the relationship between the number of child nodes (Tree Width) and the Accuracy@1 (%) for two models, GPT-4o and Claude-3, as part of a study on multimodal tree search in large vision-language models. The x-axis represents the number of child nodes, ranging from 1 to 5, with labeled points at 1, 3, and 5. The y-axis shows Accuracy@1 (%) on a linear scale, ranging from 20 to 35. The GPT-4o model, represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, shows a steady increase in accuracy from 24.4% at a tree width of 1 to a peak of 34.4% at a tree width of 4, followed by a slight decline to 31.1% at a tree width of 5. The Claude-3 model, shown with a dashed light blue line and cross markers, exhibits a more gradual increase from 26.7% at a tree width of 1 to 27.8% at a tree width of 3, then a decline to 24.4% at a tree width of 4, and finally to 20.0% at a tree width of 5. The data points are explicitly labeled with their accuracy values, providing a clear view of the performance trends for both models across different tree widths.
